inputs.sensitivity_role: Frozen reviewed input and provenance; no large-N sensitivity evolution rerun.

earlier_attempt_note.scope: Historical execution note from the preceding interactive review, not new numerical data.
earlier_attempt_note.observed: Direct NumPy dense matmul in subspace-overlap evaluation emitted divide-by-zero, overflow and invalid-value RuntimeWarnings. A subsequent dense scipy.linalg.expm attempt stopped at its internal matrix-squaring matmul under -W error on this Accelerate-backed environment.
earlier_attempt_note.resolution: Warnings were not suppressed. Dense overlap contractions were replaced by einsum(optimize=False); the independent finite-difference evolution uses DOP853 with einsum, and augmented tangents use sparse expm_multiply. The successful versions are rerun here under -W error. Failed-attempt values are not used.

subspace_tracking.scope: Numerical continuation among eight returned candidates at each sampled point; not a proof of isolation from the entire spectrum. Cosines use stored-coordinate Euclidean subspace geometry, not physical-state fidelity.
